name: 原子：种草链路 - 套图任务类型参考图负反馈优先覆盖
description: PRD：优先覆盖套图任务类型。验证套图审核任务中参考图负反馈按钮存在且交互正常；同时验证首图审核(单图)任务中参考图负反馈按钮也存在。对比套图和首图两种任务类型下负反馈功能的一致性。

steps._comment: ===== PRD：优先覆盖套图任务类型 - 查找套图审核任务 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); const taskTypes = []; for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中') || t.includes('待审核')) { const isSuite = t.includes('套图'); const isSeeding = t.includes('种草'); const isFirstImg = t.includes('首图'); taskTypes.push({ text: t.slice(0, 80), isSuite, isSeeding, isFirstImg }); } } return { totalTasks: taskTypes.length, tasks: taskTypes, hasSuiteTask: taskTypes.some(t => t.isSuite), hasSeedingTask: taskTypes.some(t => t.isSeeding) }; })()
steps.description: 扫描可用审核任务，区分套图/首图/种草

steps._comment: ===== 优先进入套图审核任务 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('套图') && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中') || t.includes('待审核'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情' || b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, taskType: '套图' }; } } } for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('种草') && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, taskType: '种草' }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 优先进入套图审核任务

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { alreadyInDetail: true }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 验证套图审核详情中参考图负反馈按钮 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const pageText = document.body.innerText; const isSuiteReview = pageText.includes('套图') || pageText.includes('SetImage') || pageText.includes('首图审核'); const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); const singleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem]'); const refHasFeedback = gridBtns.length > 0 || Array.from(singleBtns).some(b => b.querySelector('img')?.alt === '负反馈'); const resultActions = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=CoverImageReview--actionItem]'); const resultHasFeedback = Array.from(resultActions).some(a => a.querySelector('img')?.alt === '负反馈'); const feedbackBadges = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--feedbackBadge]'); return { isSuiteReview, gridBtnCount: gridBtns.length, singleBtnCount: singleBtns.length, refHasFeedback, resultHasFeedback, feedbackBadgeCount: feedbackBadges.length, badges: Array.from(feedbackBadges).map(b => b.textContent?.trim()) }; })()
steps.description: 验证套图审核中参考图和结果图负反馈按钮
【PRD核心-套图优先】断言套图审核中参考图区域存在负反馈按钮

steps._comment: ===== 验证结果图也有负反馈（两者共存） =====
steps.expression: (() => { const check = ${suiteFeedbackCheck}; return { refAndResultBothHaveFeedback: check.refHasFeedback && check.resultHasFeedback, note: 'PRD：参考图和结果图各自独立有负反馈按钮' }; })()
steps.description: 验证参考图和结果图负反馈共存

steps.label: suite-task-ref-feedback-priority
steps.description: 截图-套图任务参考图负反馈

steps._comment: ===== 点击参考图负反馈验证弹窗（套图模式） =====
steps.expression: (() => { const fbBtn = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem] img[alt="负反馈"]'); if (fbBtn) { fbBtn.closest('[class*=actionItem]').click(); return { clicked: true, mode: 'single' }; } const gridFb = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridFb) { gridFb.click(); return { clicked: true, mode: 'grid' }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击套图任务参考图负反馈

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal') || document.querySelector('.ant-popover'); if (!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const options = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper')).map(o => o.textContent?.trim()); return { hasModal: true, optionCount: options.length, options }; })()
steps.description: 验证套图模式负反馈弹窗选项
断言套图任务参考图负反馈弹窗正常弹出

steps.label: suite-task-ref-feedback-modal
steps.description: 截图-套图任务参考图负反馈弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal button, .ant-popover button')).find(b => /取\s*消|关\s*闭/.test(b.textContent)); if(btn){btn.click();return 'dismissed';} return 'no dismiss btn'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在套图审核任务（优先）和种草审核任务
_testDesign.realDomNotes: PRD：优先覆盖套图任务类型；参考图负反馈按钮在套图和首图审核中均应存在；套图审核8个按钮(无驳回)，首图审核9个按钮(含驳回)
riskPoints: 套图审核任务可能不存在
套图和首图的参考图DOM结构可能有差异
套图模式下参考图可能有多张，影响按钮显隐逻辑

prdMapping.套图优先: PRD明确优先覆盖套图任务类型
prdMapping.参考图负反馈: 套图审核详情参考图区域有负反馈按钮
prdMapping.共存验证: 参考图和结果图各自独立有负反馈入口
